insight: There's been no rain at all lately, so there's no runoff driving contamination, and strong summer sunlight is helping disinfect the water. The model's main signals right now: hours since high tide is raising risk — the timing relative to high tide affects how concentrated bacteria are at the shoreline; seasonal pattern is raising risk — seasonal patterns (wet winters vs dry summers) set the baseline risk; and limited sunlight is raising risk (less UV to disinfect the water). The most recent sample, 3 days ago, was excellent at 10 MPN/100mL.
